response.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM pairs), scored AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_type_avg FROM scored WHERE share >= avg_share GROUP BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: The average share for a trader type is taken over all of that type's pairs before the filter is applied. It is not recomputed over the kept pairs.
Inner joins drop advancedbehavior records with no matching transaction or trader. Trader types that are NULL form their own group.
